messages:
morgan: Heads-up — we saw two incidents this week where dedicated pools failed to meet burst requests because GPUs were still coming up from cold. Latency spike ~7s for first requests.
raj: ugh. same pattern as the last chaos run? slow NVMe attestation + k8s binding took a while?
claire: yes, nodes booting >> kubelet join. warmup for the runtime / model cache is another 3–6s after node ready.
morgan: I'm thinking we need a combined approach: admission backoff + controller split (fast admit vs slow reconcile). split would let an "admit" component decide quickly using headroom tokens and a separate reconciler handle long-term placement.
jordan: can you sketch failure modes? i worry split surface adds more asynchrony and leaks tokens if reconciler never finishes.
morgan: failure modes: 1) admit grants token -> request reroutes to a pool that never actually allocates (reconciler stuck). 2) reconciler races create duplicate prewarms. 3) over-eager retries thrash cloud quotas.
raj: for (1) we need lease TTL + reclaim hooks. short TTL on admitted tokens (e.g., 10s) and a reconciliation state machine that extends leases only when node reaches READY+model-cache primed.
claire: also use a graded backoff on prewarm attempts: immediate retry window small (500ms) then exponential up to 5s. prevents nonstop cloud calls.
morgan: proposal: admit component only answers yes/no based on hot headroom tokens + soft-reservation credits. It returns a temp lease id. Then reconciler must observe the temp lease within X ms and commit (convert to hard lease) only after probe success. If commit fails, admit token expires.
jordan: that seems ok. what's X? we need to set conservatively to avoid blown SLAs but also avoid hanging tokens.
claire: empirical numbers: cold GPU provisioning ~8–13s median in us-west-2, but node join ~4–7s. model priming ~2–5s. So set X = 15s commit window, but have short per-request failover: if an app sees no progress after 3s, it falls back to grace model (lower-capacity variant).
raj: on backoff strategy: exponential w/ jitter for cloud create calls. For admission retries from clients, linear small backoff so UX doesn't degrade badly. Keep separate throttles for tenant vs infra-created prewarms.
morgan: config snippet idea:
```yaml
admit: 
  temp_lease_ttl: 10s
  commit_window: 15s
  client_retry_policy:
    initial: 300ms
    max: 2s
  provision_backoff:
    base: 500ms
    multiplier: 2.0
    max: 5s
  circuit_breaker:
    fail_threshold: 5
    reset_after: 30s
```
claire: +metrics to surface: temp_lease_grants, commit_success_rate, commit_latency_histogram, provision_call_errors, prewarm_throttle_drops. We'll need dashboard and alert on commit_success_rate < 95% over 5m.
jordan: thinking operationally — rollout plan? feature flag admit_split default off. start in canary for low-volume tenant. add a synthetic that simulates node slow-join to ensure TTL reclaim works.
raj: also add a safety: if reconciler misses commit window, spin a cleanup job that releases any cloud resources created to avoid ghost nodes. tag resources w/ lease id.
morgan: what about cost implications? extra short-lived prewarms could increase cloud churn. we should gate prewarms with cost bucket and only allow burst prewarms up to credit limit.
claire: +optimize: prefer reuse of warm nodes (LRU by last-model-prime) before creating new nodes. reconciler should try soft-fit into existing partial-capacity nodes first.
jordan: API surface: admit endpoint returns {allowed: bool, lease_id: string, ttl_s: int, reason: string?}. Keep it minimal. Reconciler accepts commit(lease_id) => success/fail.
morgan: tests: unit for TTL expiry, e2e with a fake cloud provider that simulates 3 failure modes (slow node join, provisioning error, immediate success). stress test load with high-churn tenant.
raj: one extra thought — exponential backoff multiplier tuning per region/hardware type. Older infra often slower; allow region-level override.
claire: ops-bot: created ticket INF-3912 to track implementation tasks and dashboards. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Ticket INF-3912 created by claire — "Admit/Reconciler split + temp-lease/backoff policy". Priority: P2.
jordan: ok let's write a short RFC addendum with these configs and the failure-mode checklist. i'll volunteer to author the addendum.
morgan: thanks — i'll put a branch with the admit proto and a small fake-cloud harness. tagging the rest for review: @raj @claire.
claire: ack. moving to follow-up PRs. :rocket:
